title: Faisal Town Islamabad Map & Location – Phase 1 and Phase 2
description: Use the Faisal Town Islamabad map and location guide to separate Phase 1/F-18 from Phase 2/FT-II and open the correct master or sector plan.
intro: Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 and Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II are separate project areas. For Phase 2, use the full master plan for orientation and the official O, P, Q, R, S or T sector plan for plot-level checks.
body:
## Phase 1 and Phase 2 are separate

Phase 1 uses block terminology such as Block A, B and C. Phase 2 uses sectors and enclaves. Do not use a Phase 1 map to evaluate a Phase 2 plot or vice versa.

## How to use the Phase 2 master plan

The full master plan is for project-wide orientation: sector relationships, major roads and overall layout. It is not a live inventory list. Once you choose Sector O, P, Q, R, S or T, move to the sector page and use the dedicated sector plan.

## Cash-only and installment areas

Sector O, P, Q and R are currently cash-only Model Blocks. Sector S and Sector T are installment options. Overseas/W/X appear in planning material but have no current entry to promote.

## How to check a specific plot

Ask for project name, sector or block, plot number, size and a marked location. Compare that marked plan with the property documents and current on-ground location.

## Google Maps and project plans answer different questions

Google Maps can help with external routes and navigation. Project plans are needed for internal sector, street and plot context. Use both when planning a site visit.

## What to check during a site visit

Confirm the route to the exact plot, road condition, street identification, plot demarcation and nearby development. A map can show planned layout, but the current site shows what is actually accessible today.

## Avoid map confusion before payment

Do not rely on a cropped screenshot without the full project context. Ask for a full plan and a marked close-up of the exact property, then verify current availability separately.
bulletsText:
Name the project first | Start with Phase 1/F-18 or Phase 2/FT-II before discussing a block or sector.
Ask for exact plot number | A sector name alone is not enough for location verification.
Use the correct plan | Full master plan for orientation; sector plan for detailed plot position where available.
Compare with the site | Use a current visit or live video to verify practical access and development.

faqsText:
Is Faisal Town Phase 1 the same location as Phase 2? | No. They are separate project areas and should be reviewed with their own maps and page structure.
Where can I open the Phase 2 master plan? | Use the Phase 2 master plan guide or download the PDF linked from this site.
Can the master plan confirm availability? | No. It shows layout and location context. Current availability must be checked separately.
Should I use Google Maps or the project plan? | Use both. Google Maps helps with external routes; the project plan helps with internal sector and plot context.
What do I need to verify one plot? | Project, sector/block, plot number, size, marked map location and a current site or video check.
